comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-own-area.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2197): a 60 x 40 x 20 block (F1.b0) and on its top face Sketch1 (F2): a circle of diameter 16 about the middle of the face's right edge (c1), half on the face; a 50 x 60 rectangle from (-10, -10) reaching past the face's left, bottom and top edges (c3 to c6) with two circles of diameter 8 inside it, one across the face's left edge about (0, 20) (c11) and one on the face about (20, 20) (c13).
